rows.text: S. Gopalan, Returning Officer for the Presidential Election and Secretary General of the Lok Sabha, declares at New Delhi on 17 July 1997, under section 11 of the 1952 Act read with rule 35 of the 1974 Rules, that Shri Kocheril Raman Narayanan of 6, Maulana Azad Road, New Delhi has been duly elected to the office of the President of India.

locator.item: DECLARATION, dated 'New Delhi, July, 17, 1997, Asadha 26, 1919 (Saka)', signed S. Gopalan

rows.text: On 22 July 1997 the Ministry of Law and Justice publishes the declaration for general information under section 12 of the 1952 Act (S.O. 508(E), file No. 13(1)/97-Leg. II, K.L. Mohanpuria, Secretary).

locator.item: NOTIFICATION, New Delhi, the 22nd July, 1997, S.O. 508(E)

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only.
